name: Wendling's Foodservice
old_description: Founded in 1913 by Albert Wendling in Charleston, WV, our company began as a fresh meat delivery service. Now West Virginia’s largest independent food distributor, we supply over 9,000 products, including fresh meats, seafood, and non-foods across West Virginia, Virginia, Western Pennsylvania, and nearby states. We continue to honor our family-owned and operated history with personalized, customer-focused service you can count on…one customer and delivery at a time.
about:
A.F. Wendling's Foodservice traces its roots to 1913 when Albert Wendling launched a fresh meat delivery service in Charleston, West Virginia. The business remains family-owned and operated, now headquartered in Buckhannon, WV, and continues to serve the region as the state's largest independent broadline foodservice distributor.

The company stocks more than 9,000 items spanning fresh meats, seafood, frozen and refrigerated goods, and non-food supplies. Recent expansion added over 800 square feet of freezer capacity to support growing service territories across West Virginia, Virginia, and western Pennsylvania. Orders are handled through a personalized phone system where customers reach a live representative.

Primary customers include independent restaurants, institutional kitchens, and other foodservice operators throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. As a UniPro Foodservice member, the distributor carries exclusive brand lines that cater to diverse menu requirements.

The founding principle of personalized, customer-focused service — one customer and delivery at a time — remains the stated differentiator, emphasizing direct relationships over volume-driven transactions.
